dict.string: Ascend reads your recent weight and activity from Health to prefill your body metrics and keep your dashboard accurate.
Ascend writes completed workouts and logged weight to Health so all your fitness data stays in one place.
Ascend saves progress photos you choose to your photo library.
Ascend lets you attach progress photos from your library to your timeline and journal.
Ascend uses local notifications for habit reminders, workout day reminders, journal prompts, and rest timers.
